body:
Lena (arch): Quick RFC follow-up: we need a formal "retirement playbook" for compatibility shims. Goal: predictable calendaring, clear exemptions, and measurable safety gates. Sketch below.

Marco: high level OK. Need concrete math for sampling + confidence so we don't miss rare-but-important tenants.

Tala: Also legal/compliance constraints. Some customers require 12mo notice or a contract clause for breaking changes. We need a "compliance hold" flag that blocks automated pruning.

Ben: Implementation idea: three retirement classes: cosmetic (shape-only), non-semantic (headers/envelope), and semantic (tokenization/embeddings). Each class gets different windows and gates.

Lena (arch): Proposed windows:
- cosmetic: announce 30d, auto-retire 30d after announce if low usage
- non-semantic: announce 90d, opt-out for new tenants at 45d, auto-retire 180d after announce
- semantic: announce 180d, prolonged canary 30d, manual close by eng/ML, auto-retire only after eval pass + legal clear

Marco: For telemetry/sample math: mirror at 1% by default but use adaptive sampling: increase to 5% if diff rate in current sample >0.05%. Estimate 95% CI for diff rate r using Wilson score; require upper bound <0.1% to consider safe.

Tala: Compliance hold semantics: a tenant can be labeled `compat:hold` with a reason and expiration. Holds are surfaced in the UI and override auto-retire. Holds can be created by legal, support, or account owners. Also include an "indefinite" checkbox for special contracts.

Ben: Data model for shim metadata (string fields only in this doc):
```
shim_id: v3-legacy-stream-envelope
class: non-semantic
announced_at: 2025-02-10
auto_retire_at: 2025-08-10
telemetry_rule: sample_1pct|increase_on_diff
prune_state: candidate|scheduled|retired
prune_ticket: SUP-12345
```

Marco: On detection rules: combine per-tenant hit-rate (mean hits/day over 30d) and unique-tenant coverage. Condition to qualify for auto-retire: global_mean_hits < 10/day AND unique_tenants < 5 OR (global_sample_diff_rate < 0.001 AND upper_CI < 0.001). Also exclude tenants with `compat:hold` or support tickets tagged in last 90d.

Lena (arch): Audit requirements: every lifecycle transition record must be immutable, include actor (system or user), rationale (telemetry, ticket), and a pointer to the snapshot of the diff artifacts (s3 key). Retire job must create reversible feature-flag per-tenant that can be flipped within 14d. After 14d auto-delete the flag.

Tala: For regulated customers, add a "contractual_retire_date" field and ensure comms show that explicit date. Also integrate with billing so any removal that changes SLA or feature availability triggers account manager notification.

Ben: Safety gates for semantic shims:
1) eval-sim replay on representative corpus (target: 200k requests)
2) model-quality metrics (embedding MRR, token divergence) must be within drift thresholds
3) 2-week real-tenant canary across opt-in tenants (min 3 tenants or 1% traffic)
Only after all pass can an engineer mark "ready_for_prune".

Marco: Ops automation: prune pipeline should run weekly, generate a candidate list, compute stats, notify `#retire-review` with templated summary and a 48h manual review window. If no objection, schedule prune at low-traffic hour and create audit + revert flag.

comms-bot: announcement template created: `shim_retire_notice_v1` (staging).

Lena (arch): Edge cases:
- Shims that quietly mask data-loss (we must treat as semantic)
- On-prem customers without telemetry (require manual opt-in to run compatibility checks or rely on ticket history)
- Third-party integrators that embed old SDKs (we need SDK telemetry header enforcement)

Tala: Suggest UI changes: admin console show per-shim timeline, hold controls, and quick-run compatibility check that tenants can trigger. Also add a link to request extended legal hold.

Ben: Metrics to surface: daily shim hit count, unique tenants, mirror diff rate, upper CI, open tickets count, and days-to-auto-retire. Dashboard tile + exportable CSV for audits.

Lena (arch): Action items: @Marco write sampling + CI queries, @Tala spec compliance-hold API + UI copy, @Ben add prune job orchestration + revert flag, I'll draft RFC addendum and runbook. Schedule 30m sync Fri to finalize thresholds.

Marco: ack

Tala: ack

Ben: ack

comms-bot: scheduled: retire-playbook-sync Fri 10:00
